headline: Unanimous Strong Buy, real upside left
chart_note: 52-week range: $464.52 - $601.62. Currently $568.87, about 5% below its high.
why_today: Mastercard trades just below its 52-week high, riding the same global payments tailwind as Visa. Every one of the 37 analysts covering the stock rates it a Buy - a rare unanimous call.
pro_1: 37 of 37 analysts rate it Buy, average price target of $671 implies nearly 18% further upside
pro_2: Trading only about 5% below its 52-week high shows sustained investor confidence through the year
con_1: PE of 30.2x leaves little room for a slowdown in global consumer spending
con_2: Duopoly with Visa means both stocks are exposed to the same regulatory and macro risks together
